scientific_integrity: Analytic W1 coupling, moment identities and triangular-array martingale central limit proof; auxiliary exact finite-state rational checks. Known rounding/AR identities credited; novelty remains subject to independent priority review.
scientific_limitations: Exact one-step final rounding onto an infinite regular integer lattice on a single scalar quadratic; iid random seeds; stationary limit as the stable step approaches the flip boundary. No IEEE intermediate rounding, multivariate model, or simultaneous time/stepsize limit.
title: Lattice-phase Gaussian law at the flip boundary of stochastic-rounding descent
